question: Town C is west of town D. Town E is south of the mid-point of the line joining C and D. Town F is south-west of C such that F and E are along the same straight line. What is the position of E with respect to F?
solution:
Given: 

Town C is west of town D.

Town E is south of the mid-point of the line joining C and D.

Town F is south-west of C such that F and E are along the same straight line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1d714007397e930833101521c9b214d4d816a9c61e43f2ad3b561428ead68a7.png] 

So, the position of E with respect to F is **East**.

Hence, the correct answer is "East".
